content.text:
Repaired and resubmitted.

**What changed from the prior turn:**

1. **§ 21.1 lookback anchor** — the cap now reads "the greater of (a) the fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000", replacing the "event giving rise to the claim" anchor so the preferred element's temporal basis is met literally.

2. **§ 21.3 payment carve-out** — now "Customer's payment obligations, including undisputed amounts due for conforming Services, are not damages and are not limited by this Section", so the carve-out reaches Customer payment obligations generally rather than the narrow defined "Fees", while retaining the "undisputed"/"conforming Services" qualifiers verbatim.

Everything else in Section 21 is untouched: the mutual cap sentence, the mutual indirect-damages exclusion and direct-damages list in § 21.2, and the full Excluded Claims list, all of which are mapped as already met from existing text. Classification remains **deviation** (critical): the original cap keyed to "Fees" = the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee under the first Order Form sat below the six-months'-fees walk-away floor.
